newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -Telmex 96 EPS forecast cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Telmex 96 EPS forecast cut.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Rizwan Ali said he was lowering his 1996 earnings estimate per Telmex ADR to $3.70 from $4.00 and Q4 1996 estimate to $0.52 from $0.82.

-- He said Telmex has said it plans to take a one-time charge of 1.6 billion pesos ($202.5 million), or $0.45 per ADR, in the fourth quarter of 1996. On an after-tax basis, the charge would amount to $0.30 per ADR.

-- "This extraordinary item represents a writeoff of goodwill generated by Telmex's acquisition of Cablevision and Red Uno last year, and its acquisition of a microwave network from the government in 1989," the Bear Stearns report said.
